579void
580FileGenerateMWn::dataSetupFromDictionary() {
581
582 utf8VaryingString wStr;
583
584 if (MasterFile!=nullptr) {
585 if (MasterFile->Dictionary!=nullptr) {
586 if (MasterFile->getRecordCount()>0) {
587 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Load dictionary",Severity_Error,
588 nullptr,nullptr,
589 "A master file with %ld active records has been loaded %s,\n"
590 "This file has its own dictionary <%s>.\n"
591 "It is requested to change its embedded dictionary.\n"
592 "This change is not allowed since it could corrupt its content.\n"
593 "In place, create a new master file with this dictionary and transfer data to it.",
594 MasterFile->getRecordCount(),
595 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
596 MasterFile->Dictionary->DicName.toString());
597 return;
598 } //if (MasterFile->getRecordCount()>0)
599
600 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B("Load dictionary",Severity_Information,
601 "Quit","Aggree",nullptr,nullptr,
602 "An empty master file has been loaded %s,\n"
603 "This file has its own dictionary <%s>.\n"
604 "Some master parameters might be changed.\n"
605 "%ld keys will be created. Some may be redundant.\n"
606 "Loading a new dictionary will request to change current dictionary with the loaded one.\n",
607 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
608 MasterFile->Dictionary->DicName.toString(),
609 MasterFile->Dictionary->KeyDic.count());
610 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
611 return;
612 }// if (MasterFile->Dictionary!=nullptr)
613 } // if (MasterFile!=nullptr)
614
615 wStr.sprintf("Loaded dictionary <%s>",DictionaryFile->DicName.toString());
616 DicLoadLBl->setText(wStr.toCChar());
617
618
619 if (MasterFile==nullptr) {
620 AllocatedBlocks = cst_ZRF_default_allocation;
621 wStr.sprintf("%ld",AllocatedBlocks);
622 AllocatedLEd->setText(wStr.toCChar());
623
624
625 ExtentQuota = cst_ZRF_default_extentquota;
626 wStr.sprintf("%ld",ExtentQuota);
627 ExtentQuotaLEd->setText(wStr.toCChar());
628
629 GrabFreeSpace = true;
630 HighWaterMarking = false;
631 }
632 for (long wi=0; wi < DictionaryFile->KeyDic.count() ; wi++) {
633
634 ZKeyDictionary* wKeyDic=DictionaryFile->KeyDic.Tab(wi);
635
636 KeyData wKeyData;
637 wKeyData.IndexName = wKeyDic->DicKeyName;
638 wKeyData.KeySize = wKeyDic->KeyGuessedSize;
639 wKeyData.Forced = wKeyDic->Forced;
640 // wKeyData.KeySize = AllocatedBlocks*wKeyDic->computeKeyUniversalSize();
641 wKeyData.Allocated = AllocatedBlocks;
642 wKeyData.AllocatedSize = wKeyData.KeySize * wKeyData.Allocated;
643 wKeyData.ExtentQuota = ExtentQuota;
644 wKeyData.ExtentSize = wKeyData.KeySize * wKeyData.ExtentQuota;
645 wKeyData.IndexRootName = generateIndexRootName(RootName,wKeyDic->DicKeyName);
646 wKeyData.Duplicates = wKeyDic->Duplicates;
647
648 wKeyData.GrabFreeSpace = GrabFreeSpace ;
649 wKeyData.HighwaterMarking = false ;
650 long wR = KeyValues->push(wKeyData);
651 if (MasterFile!=nullptr) {
652 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_KeyDicAppend);
653 wChgRec.setPostKeyData(wKeyData);
654 wChgRec.setIndexRank (wR);
655 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
656 ComLog->appendText("Created ChangeLog record : new key <%s> waiting for creation.",
657 wKeyData.IndexName.toString());
658 }
659 else {
660 ComLog->appendText("New key <%s> appended. No change record created.",
661 wKeyData.IndexName.toString());
662 }
663
664 }// for
665
666 Compute(); /* recompute first mean record size and then all sizes */
667
668 _dataSetup();
669
670 QVariant wV;
671
672 for (long wi=0;wi < DictionaryFile->count();wi++) {
673 if (DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).UniversalSize==0) {
674 QList<QStandardItem*> wGuessRow;
675 wGuessRow << createItem(DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).getName());
676 wGuessRow[0]->setEditable(false);
677 wGuessRow << createItem(decode_ZType( DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).ZType));
678 wGuessRow.last()->setEditable(false);
679 wGuessRow << createItem(DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).HeaderSize);
680 wGuessRow.last()->setEditable(false);
681 wGuessRow << createItem(DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).UniversalSize);
682 wGuessRow.last()->setEditable(true);
683
684 GuessTBv->ItemModel->appendRow(wGuessRow);
685 if (!GuessGBx->isVisible())
686 GuessGBx->setVisible(true);
687
688 wStr.sprintf( "%s-W-INVSIZ Size value for field <%s> has not been guessed and remains invalid.",
689 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
690 wGuessRow[0]->text().toUtf8().data());
691 ComLog->appendTextColor(WarnedQCl, wStr);
692 }
693 }// for
694
695 testGuessed();
696
697 for (int wi=0;wi < GuessTBv->ItemModel->columnCount();wi++)
698 GuessTBv->resizeColumnToContents(wi);
699 for (int wi=0;wi < GuessTBv->ItemModel->rowCount();wi++)
700 GuessTBv->resizeRowToContents(wi);
701
702 QObject::connect(GuessTBv->ItemModel,&QStandardItemModel::itemChanged,this,&FileGenerateMWn::GuessItemChanged);
703
704 State |= FGST_FDic;
705} // dataSetupFromDictionary

708bool
709FileGenerateMWn::dataSetupFromMasterFile(const uriString& pURIMaster) {
710 utf8VaryingString wStr;
711 wStr.sprintf("Loading parameters from existing master file <%s>.",pURIMaster.toString());
712 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
713
714 if (ChangeLog.count()!=0) {
715 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Load master file",Severity_Error,
716 nullptr,nullptr,
717 "There are pending changes (count %ld)"
718 "concerning master file %s,\n"
719 "Apply changes first then load another current file.\n",
720 ChangeLog.count(),
721 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
722 return false;
723 }
724 if (MasterFile!=nullptr) {
725 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B("Load master file",Severity_Warning,
726 "Do not load","Load anyway",nullptr,nullptr,
727 "A master file has been loaded :%s,\n"
728 "Loading a new file will disregard current changes for this file.\n",
729 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
730 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
731 return false;
732
733 ComLog->appendTextColor(QColor(),WarnedQCl, "%s-W-ALRDYLD A file has already being loaded/created <%s>.",
734 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
735 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
736
737 if (MasterFile->isOpen()) {
738 ComLog->appendText("Closing current file prior of loading new master file.");
739 MasterFile->zclose();
740 }
741 delete MasterFile;
742 }
743 MasterFile = new ZMasterFile;
744 ZStatus wSt=MasterFile->zopen(pURIMaster,ZRF_All | ZRF_TypeRegardless);
745 if (wSt < 0) {
746 ComLog->appendText("Cannot open requested file.");
747 ZExceptionDLg::displayLast("Opening Master file");
748 ComLog->appendTextColor(ErroredQCl, "%s-E-CANTLD Cannot load requested file.\n%s",
749 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toString());
750 delete MasterFile;
751 MasterFile = nullptr;
752 return false;
753 }
754
755 if (MasterFile->hasDictionary()) {
756 SourceLBl->setText("Master file");
757 DicEmbedLBl->setText(MasterFile->Dictionary->DicName.toCChar());
758 wStr.sprintf("Loaded file has an associated dictionary <%s>.",MasterFile->Dictionary->DicName.toString());
759 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
760 if (MasterFile->getFileType()!= ZFT_ZMasterFile ) {
761 ComLog->appendTextColor(QColor(),WarnedQCl, "%s-W-BADTYP File has a dictionary, though its file type is %s",
762 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
763 decode_ZFile_type(MasterFile->getFileType()));
764 }
765 if (DictionaryFile!=nullptr) {
766 ComLog->appendText("Currently loaded external dictionary %s is made unavailable.",
767 DictionaryFile->URIDictionary.toString());
768 delete DictionaryFile;
769 DicLoadLBl->setText("No loaded dictionary");
770 }
771
772 wStr.sprintf("Embedded Dictionary <%s>",MasterFile->Dictionary->DicName.toCChar());
773 DicEmbedLBl->setText(wStr.toCChar());
774 }
775 else {
776 SourceLBl->setText("Raw master file");
777 ComLog->appendText("Loaded file has no dictionary and is a raw master file.");
778 }
779
780 SourceContentLBl->setText(pURIMaster.toCChar());
781
782 TargetDirectory = MasterFile->getURIContent().getDirectoryPath();
783 IndexDirectory = MasterFile->IndexFilePath;
784
785 RootName = MasterFile->getURIContent().getRootname();
786 MeanRecordSize = MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockTargetSize;
787 AllocatedBlocks = MasterFile->getFCB()->AllocatedBlocks;
788 AllocatedSize = MasterFile->getFileSize();
789 ExtentQuota = MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota;
790 ExtentQuotaSize = MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota*MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockTargetSize;
791
792 InitialSize= MasterFile->getFCB()->InitialSize;
793
794 GrabFreeSpace = MasterFile->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace;
795 HighWaterMarking = MasterFile->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking;
796 Journaling = MasterFile->hasJournal();
797
798 KeyTBv->ItemModel->removeRows(0,KeyTBv->ItemModel->rowCount());
799
800 KeyData wKeyData;
801 KeyValues->clear();
802
803 for (long wi=0; wi < MasterFile->IndexTable.count(); wi++) {
804 wKeyData.clear();
805 // uriString wIndexURI = MasterFile->getURIIndex(wi);
806 wKeyData.IndexRootName = MasterFile->getURIIndex(wi).getRootname();
807 wKeyData.IndexName = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->IndexName ;
808 wKeyData.KeySize = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->KeyGuessedSize;
809 wKeyData.Allocated = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->getFCB()->AllocatedBlocks;
810 wKeyData.AllocatedSize = wKeyData.KeySize * wKeyData.Allocated;
811 wKeyData.ExtentQuota = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota;
812 wKeyData.ExtentSize = wKeyData.ExtentQuota * wKeyData.KeySize;
813 wKeyData.Duplicates = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->Duplicates;
814 wKeyData.GrabFreeSpace = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace;
815 wKeyData.HighwaterMarking = MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking;
816
817 KeyValues->push(wKeyData);
818 }
819
820 _dataSetup();
821
822 return true;
823} // dataSetupFromFile

827
828ZStatus FileGenerateMWn::XmlDefinitionSave(uriString &pXmlFile, bool pComment) {
829 utf8VaryingString wReturn = fmtXMLdeclaration();
830 int wLevel=0;
831 wReturn += fmtXMLnodeWithAttributes("zicm","version",__ZRF_XMLVERSION_CONTROL__,0);
832
833 /*----------------------Content---------------------------------*/
834 wReturn += fmtXMLnode("filedefinition",wLevel);
835 wLevel++;
836
837 if (TargetDirectory.isEmpty())
838 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("targetdirectory"," ",wLevel);
839 else
840 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("targetdirectory",TargetDirectory.toCChar(),wLevel);
841
842 if (IndexDirectory.isEmpty())
843 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("indexdirectory"," ",wLevel);
844 else
845 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("indexdirectory",IndexDirectory.toCChar(),wLevel);
846
847 if (RootName.isEmpty())
848 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("rootname"," ",wLevel);
849 else
850 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("rootname",RootName.toCChar(),wLevel);
851
852
853 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("meanrecordsize",MeanRecordSize,wLevel);
854 if (pComment)
855 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Average size of record (varying record size). Updated by file record engine.");
856
857 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("allocatedblocks",AllocatedBlocks,wLevel);
858 if (pComment)
859 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Number of allocated blocks in block access table.");
860 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("allocatedsize",AllocatedSize,wLevel);
861 if (pComment)
862 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Size in bytes allocated to these blocks.");
863
864 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("extentquota",ExtentQuota,wLevel);
865 if (pComment)
866 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Number of blocks extended for each file extent operation.");
867
868 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("extentquotasize",ExtentQuotaSize,wLevel);
869 if (pComment)
870 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Size in bytes extended for each file extent operation.");
871
872 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("initialblocks",InitialBlocks,wLevel);
873 if (pComment)
874 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Number of blocks initially allocated to file during its creation.");
875
876 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("initialsize",InitialSize,wLevel);
877 if (pComment)
878 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Size in bytes initially allocated to file during its creation.");
879
880 wReturn+=fmtXMLbool("grabfreespace",GrabFreeSpace,wLevel);
881 if (pComment)
882 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Defines wether engine should try to gather free space once deallocated.");
883
884 wReturn+=fmtXMLbool("highwatermarking",HighWaterMarking,wLevel);
885 if (pComment)
886 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Defines wether engine should binary zero any freed space.");
887
888 wReturn+=fmtXMLbool("journaling",Journaling,wLevel);
889 if (pComment)
890 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Defines if journaling is set or not (NB: indexes are never journalized).");
891
892
893 /* --keys-- */
894 if (KeyValues!=nullptr) {
895 wReturn += fmtXMLnode("keyvalues",wLevel);
896 wLevel++;
897 for (long wi=0; wi < KeyValues->count();wi++) {
898 wReturn += fmtXMLnode("keyitem",wLevel);
899 wLevel++;
900
901 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("keysize",KeyValues->Tab(wi).KeySize,wLevel);
902 if (pComment)
903 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Total size in bytes of the key or guessed key size if key is composed of one or more varying fields.");
904 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("allocated",KeyValues->Tab(wi).Allocated,wLevel);
905 if (pComment)
906 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Number of allocated block in index file.");
907 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("allocatedsize",KeyValues->Tab(wi).AllocatedSize,wLevel);
908 if (pComment)
909 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Total size in bytes of the key or guessed key size if key is composed of one or more varying fields.");
910 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("extentquota",KeyValues->Tab(wi).ExtentQuota,wLevel);
911 if (pComment)
912 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Total number of blocks index file will be extended at each extent operation.");
913 wReturn+=fmtXMLlong("extentsize",KeyValues->Tab(wi).ExtentSize,wLevel);
914 if (pComment)
915 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Total size in bytes index file will be extended at each extent operation.");
916 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("indexrootname",KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexRootName.toString(),wLevel);
917 if (pComment)
918 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Root name for building index file name.It is concatenated with embedded index directory if defined at master file level or with master file's default directory if none.");
919 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("indexname",KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.toString(),wLevel);
920 if (pComment)
921 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Name for the key - index.");
922 wReturn+=fmtXMLchar("duplicate",decode_ZST(KeyValues->Tab(wi).Duplicates),wLevel);
923 if (pComment)
924 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"Defines wether key accepts or not duplicates.");
925 wReturn+=fmtXMLbool("grabfreespace",bool(KeyValues->Tab(wi).GrabFreeSpace),wLevel);
926 if (pComment)
927 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"If set file engine will try to gather free blocks and holes together.Not usefull is key has a fixed size.");
928 wReturn+=fmtXMLbool("highwatermarking",bool(KeyValues->Tab(wi).HighwaterMarking),wLevel);
929 if (pComment)
930 fmtXMLaddInlineComment(wReturn,"If set each deleted block from the key will be set to binary zero by file engine.This is not much relevant because of time consummed by operation vs confidentiality.");
931
932 wLevel--;
933 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("keyitem",wLevel);
934 } // for
935
936 wLevel--;
937 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("keyvalues",wLevel);
938 } // if (KeyValues!=nullptr)
939 /* --end keys-- */
940
941 wLevel--;
942 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("filedefinition",wLevel);
943 wLevel--;
944 /*----------------------End Content---------------------------------*/
945 wReturn += fmtXMLendnode("zicm",0);
946
947 return pXmlFile.writeContent(wReturn);
948}// FileGenerateDLg::XmlSave
949
950
951ZStatus
952FileGenerateMWn::XmlDefinitionLoad(const utf8VaryingString& pXmlContent, ZaiErrors* pErrorLog) {
953
954 MasterFileValues wZMFVal;
955
956 ZStatus wSt;
957
958 zxmlDoc *wDoc = nullptr;
959 zxmlElement *wRoot = nullptr;
960 zxmlElement *wRootNode=nullptr;
961 zxmlElement *wKeyRootNode=nullptr;
962 zxmlElement *wSingleKeyNode=nullptr;
963 zxmlElement *wSwapNode=nullptr;
964
965 utf8VaryingString wValue;
966
967 pErrorLog->setContext("FileGenerateDLg::XmlLoad");
968
969 wDoc = new zxmlDoc;
970 wSt=wDoc->XmlParseFromMemory(pXmlContent,pErrorLog);
971 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
972 return wSt;
973
974 wSt = wDoc->getRootElement(wRoot);
975 if (wSt != ZS_SUCCESS) {
976 pErrorLog->logZExceptionLast("FileGenerateMWn::XmlDefinitionLoad");
977 return wSt;
978 }
979 if (!(wRoot->getName() == "zicm")) {
980 pErrorLog->errorLog(
981 "FileGenerateDLg::XmlLoad-E-INVROOT Invalid root node name <%s> expected <zicm>",
982 wRoot->getName().toCChar());
983 return ZS_XMLINVROOTNAME;
984 }
985
986
987 /*----------------------Master File Values Content---------------------------------*/
988
989 wSt=wRoot->getChildByName((zxmlNode*&)wRootNode,"filedefinition");
990 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
991 {
992 pErrorLog->logZStatus(
993 ZAIES_Error,
994 wSt,
995 "FileGenerateDLg::XmlLoadE-CNTFINDND Error cannot find node element with name <%s> status <%s>",
996 "filedefinition",
997 decode_ZStatus(wSt));
998 return wSt;
999 }
1000 XMLgetChildText(wRootNode,"targetdirectory",wZMFVal.TargetDirectory,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1001 XMLgetChildText(wRootNode,"indexdirectory",wZMFVal.IndexDirectory,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1002 XMLgetChildText(wRootNode,"rootname",wZMFVal.RootName,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1003
1004 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"meanrecordsize",(long&)wZMFVal.MeanRecordSize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1005 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"allocatedblocks",(long&)wZMFVal.AllocatedBlocks,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1006 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"allocatedsize",(long&)wZMFVal.AllocatedSize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1007 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"extentquota",(long&)wZMFVal.ExtentQuota,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1008 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"extentquotasize",(long&)wZMFVal.ExtentQuotaSize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1009 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"initialblocks",(long&)wZMFVal.InitialBlocks,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1010 XMLgetChildLong(wRootNode,"initialsize",(long&)wZMFVal.InitialSize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1011
1012 XMLgetChildBool(wRootNode,"journaling",wZMFVal.Journaling,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1013 XMLgetChildBool(wRootNode,"highwatermarking",wZMFVal.HighWaterMarking,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1014 XMLgetChildBool(wRootNode,"grabfreespace",wZMFVal.GrabFreeSpace,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1015
1016 wSt=wRootNode->getChildByName((zxmlNode*&)wKeyRootNode,"keyvalues");
1017 if (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
1018 wSt=wKeyRootNode->getFirstChild((zxmlNode*&)wSingleKeyNode);
1019 while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
1020 {
1021 KeyData wKeyD;
1022 XMLgetChildLong(wSingleKeyNode,"keysize",(long&)wKeyD.KeySize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1023 XMLgetChildLong(wSingleKeyNode,"allocated",(long&)wKeyD.Allocated,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1024 XMLgetChildLong(wSingleKeyNode,"allocatedsize",(long&)wKeyD.AllocatedSize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1025 XMLgetChildLong(wSingleKeyNode,"extentquota",(long&)wKeyD.ExtentQuota,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1026 XMLgetChildLong(wSingleKeyNode,"extentsize",(long&)wKeyD.ExtentSize,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1027
1028 // XMLgetChildBool(wSingleKeyNode,"duplicate",wKeyD.Duplicates,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1029 XMLgetChildText(wSingleKeyNode,"duplicate",wValue,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1030 wKeyD.Duplicates = encode_ZST(wValue.toCChar());
1031 if (wKeyD.Duplicates==ZST_Nothing)
1032 wKeyD.Duplicates = ZST_NoDuplicates;
1033 XMLgetChildBool(wSingleKeyNode,"grabfreespace",wKeyD.GrabFreeSpace,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1034 XMLgetChildBool(wSingleKeyNode,"highwatermarking",wKeyD.HighwaterMarking,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1035
1036 XMLgetChildText(wSingleKeyNode,"indexname",wKeyD.IndexName,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1037 XMLgetChildText(wSingleKeyNode,"indexrootname",wKeyD.IndexRootName,pErrorLog,ZAIES_Warning);
1038
1039 if (wZMFVal.KeyValues==nullptr) {
1040 wZMFVal.KeyValues=new zbs::ZArray<KeyData>;
1041 }
1042 wZMFVal.KeyValues->push(wKeyD);
1043
1044 wSt=wSingleKeyNode->getNextNode((zxmlNode*&)wSwapNode);
1045 XMLderegister(wSingleKeyNode);
1046 wSingleKeyNode=wSwapNode;
1047 }// while
1048
1049 //-------------------------------------------------------------
1050
1051 XMLderegister(wKeyRootNode);
1052 XMLderegister((zxmlNode *&) wRootNode);
1053 XMLderegister((zxmlNode *&) wRoot);
1054
1055
1056 MasterFileValues::_copyFrom(wZMFVal);
1057
1058 return ZS_SUCCESS;
1059} // FileGenerateDLg::XmlLoad

1120
1121QList<QStandardItem*>
1122FileGenerateMWn::formatKeyRow(KeyData& pKey) {
1123 utf8VaryingString wStr;
1124 QList<QStandardItem*> wKeyRow;
1125 wKeyRow.clear();
1126 wKeyRow << new QStandardItem(pKey.IndexName.toCChar());
1127 wKeyRow << new QStandardItem(pKey.IndexRootName.toCChar());
1128 wStr.sprintf("%ld",pKey.KeySize);
1129 wKeyRow.push_back(new QStandardItem(wStr.toCChar()));
1130 wKeyRow.last()->setTextAlignment(Qt::AlignRight);
1131#ifdef __DEPRECATED__
1132 QStandardItem* wDup=new QStandardItem("Duplicates");
1133 wDup->setTextAlignment(Qt::AlignLeft);
1134 wDup->setCheckable(true);
1135
1136 if (pKey.Duplicates) {
1137 wDup->setCheckState(Qt::Checked);
1138 wDup->setText("Duplicates");
1139 }
1140 else {
1141 wDup->setCheckState(Qt::Unchecked);
1142 wDup->setText("No duplicates");
1143 }
1144#endif
1145
1146 QStandardItem* wDup = ComboDelegate->generateItemWithIndex(int(pKey.Duplicates));
1147 QStandardItem* wGrab=new QStandardItem("GrabFreeSpace");
1148 wGrab->setCheckable(true);
1149 if (pKey.GrabFreeSpace) {
1150 wGrab->setCheckState(Qt::Checked);
1151 }
1152 else {
1153 wGrab->setCheckState(Qt::Unchecked);
1154 }
1155 QStandardItem* wHigh=new QStandardItem("Highwater");
1156 wHigh->setCheckable(true);
1157 if (pKey.HighwaterMarking) {
1158 wHigh->setCheckState(Qt::Checked);
1159 }
1160 else {
1161 wHigh->setCheckState(Qt::Unchecked);
1162 }
1163
1164 wDup->setEditable(true);
1165 wKeyRow.push_back(wDup);
1166
1167 wGrab->setEditable(true);
1168 wKeyRow.push_back(wGrab);
1169
1170 wHigh->setEditable(true);
1171 wKeyRow.push_back(wHigh);
1172
1173 wKeyRow << createItemAligned(pKey.Allocated,Qt::AlignRight,"%ld");
1174 wKeyRow.last()->setEditable(true);
1175
1176 wKeyRow << createItemAligned(pKey.AllocatedSize,Qt::AlignRight,"%ld");
1177 wKeyRow.last()->setEditable(false);
1178
1179 wKeyRow << createItemAligned(pKey.ExtentQuota,Qt::AlignRight,"%ld");
1180 wKeyRow.last()->setEditable(true);
1181
1182 wKeyRow << createItemAligned(pKey.ExtentSize,Qt::AlignRight,"%ld");
1183 wKeyRow.last()->setEditable(false);
1184
1185 return wKeyRow;
1186}

1269void
1270FileGenerateMWn::DataImport(){
1271 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
1272 if (MasterFile==nullptr) {
1273 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Data import",Severity_Error,
1274 "Please select an active, valid master file before feeding its data.");
1275 return;
1276 }
1277 if (MasterFile->getRecordCount() > 0) {
1278 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B("Data import",Severity_Error, "Cancel","Confirm",&ErrorLog,nullptr,
1279 "There are existing records within selected master file.\n"
1280 "This may cause further malfunctions.\n"
1281 "Please confirm import <Confirm> or cancel operation <Cancel>");
1282 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
1283 return;
1284 }
1285
1286 QString wDir;
1287 wDir = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(this,"Import content",GeneralParameters.getWorkDirectory().toCChar(),"Xml files (*.xml);;All (*.*)");
1288 if (wDir.isEmpty())
1289 return;
1290 uriString wURIImport=wDir.toUtf8().data();
1291
1292 /* export progress window setup */
1293
1294 ProgressMWn=new ZMFProgressMWn("Data import",this,false);
1295
1296 ProgressMWn->setDescBudy("File");
1297 ProgressMWn->setDescText(wURIImport);
1298
1299 ProgressMWn->advanceSetupCallBack(MasterFile->getRecordCount(),"Data import");
1300
1301 MasterFile->registerProgressSetupCallBack(std::bind(&ZMFProgressMWn::advanceSetupCallBack, ProgressMWn,_1,_2));
1302 MasterFile->registerProgressCallBack(std::bind(&ZMFProgressMWn::advanceCallBack, ProgressMWn,_1,_2));
1303
1304 ProgressMWn->show();
1305
1306 if (!MasterFile->isOpen())
1307 wSt=MasterFile->zopen(ZRF_All);
1308
1309 wSt=MasterFile->XmlImportContentByChunk( wURIImport,ZEXOP_CheckName | ZEXOP_CheckZType, &ErrorLog);
1310
1311 ProgressMWn->setDone(wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS);
1312
1313 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
1314 ErrorLog.errorLog("Data import: Something went wrong while importing data from <%s>",MasterFile->getURIContent().getBasename().toCChar());
1315 return;
1316 }
1317
1318 return;
1319} // DataImport

1325}//FileGenerateDLg::DataExport

1341 "There are %ld changes that haven't been applied.\n"

1437void
1438FileGenerateMWn::KeyItemChanged(QStandardItem* pItem){
1439
1440 if (DoNotChangeKeyValues) {
1441 DoNotChangeKeyValues=false;
1442 return;
1443 }
1444
1445 utf8VaryingString wStr;
1446
1447 QVariant wV;
1448 wStr = pItem->text().toUtf8().data();
1449 size_t wValue=getValueFromString<size_t>(wStr);
1450
1451 QStandardItem* wMainKeyItem = KeyTBv->ItemModel->item(pItem->row(),0);
1452
1453 const char* wName=nullptr;
1454 int wCol = pItem->column();
1455
1456 switch (wCol) {
1457
1458 case cst_IndexNameCol: {
1459 utf8VaryingString wName = pItem->text().toUtf8().data() ;
1460
1461 for (long wi=0; wi < KeyValues->count(); wi++) {
1462 if (wName == KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName) {
1463 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Change index name",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
1464 "An index with name <%s> already exists in index table.\n"
1465 "Cannot add this index to index table.",wName.toString());
1466 DoNotChangeKeyValues = true;
1467 pItem->setText(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName.toCChar());
1468 return;
1469 }
1470 }
1471
1472 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1473 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_INameChange);
1474 wChgRec.setChangeKey(wName);
1475 wChgRec.setAnteString(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1476 wChgRec.setPostString(wName);
1477 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1478 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1479
1480 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName = wName ;
1481
1482 wStr.sprintf( "%s Key rank %d index name has been changed to <%s>. col %d",
1483 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1484 pItem->row(),
1485 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data() ,
1486 wCol);
1487
1488 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1489 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1490 return ;
1491 } // cst_IndexNameCol
1492
1493 case cst_KeyDupCol: {
1494
1495 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1496 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_ChgDuplicate);
1497 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1498 wChgRec.setAnteZSortType(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates);
1499 QVariant wV = pItem->data(ZQtDataReference);
1500 ZDataReference wDRef=wV.value<ZDataReference>();
1501
1502 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates= (ZSort_Type)wDRef.DataRank;
1503 wChgRec.setPostZSortType(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates);
1504 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1505 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1506
1507// KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates = (pItem->checkState()==Qt::Checked)?ZST_NoDuplicates:ZST_Duplicates ;
1508 wV=pItem->data(ZQtDataReference);
1509 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates = (ZSort_Type) wV.value<ZDataReference>().DataRank ;
1510 wStr.sprintf( "%s Key <%s> : Duplicates has been set to <%s>. col %d",
1511 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1512 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1513 decode_ZST(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates) ,
1514 wCol );
1515 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1516/* if (KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Duplicates==ZST_Duplicates) {
1517 DoNotChangeKeyValues = true;
1518 pItem->setText("Duplicates");
1519 }
1520 else {
1521 DoNotChangeKeyValues = true;
1522 pItem->setText("No duplicates");
1523 }
1524*/
1525 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1526
1527 return ;
1528 }//cst_KeyDupCol
1529
1530 case cst_KeyGrabCol: {
1531 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1532 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1533 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_ChgGrab);
1534 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1535 wChgRec.setAnteBool(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).GrabFreeSpace);
1536 wChgRec.setPostBool(pItem->checkState()==Qt::Checked );
1537 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1538 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1539
1540 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).GrabFreeSpace = pItem->checkState()==Qt::Checked ;
1541 wStr.sprintf( "%s Key <%s> : GrabFreeSpace has been set to <%s>. col %d",
1542 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1543 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1544 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).GrabFreeSpace?"true":"false" ,
1545 wCol );
1546 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1547
1548 return ;
1549 }//cst_KeyGrabCol
1550
1551 case cst_KeyHighCol: {
1552 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1553 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1554 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_ChgHigh);
1555 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1556 wChgRec.setAnteBool(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).HighwaterMarking);
1557 wChgRec.setPostBool(pItem->checkState()==Qt::Checked );
1558 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1559 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1560
1561 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).HighwaterMarking = pItem->checkState()==Qt::Checked ;
1562
1563 wStr.sprintf( "%s Key <%s> : HighwaterMarking has been set to <%s>. col %d",
1564 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1565 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1566 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).HighwaterMarking?"true":"false",
1567 wCol);
1568 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1569
1570
1571 return ;
1572 }//cst_KeyHighCol
1573
1574 /* Changing key size induces or may induce a change on
1575 * KeySize
1576 * Allocation (if allocation is zero then set to default allocation)
1577 * AllocationSize
1578 */
1579 case cst_KeySizeCol: {
1580 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1581 wStr = pItem->text().toUtf8().data();
1582 wValue=getValueFromString<size_t>(wStr);
1583
1584 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1585 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_ChgKeySize);
1586 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1587 wChgRec.setAnteU64(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).KeySize);
1588 wChgRec.setPostU64(wValue);
1589 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1590 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1591
1592 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).KeySize = wValue;
1593 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value <Guessed key size> for key <%s> has been guessed to <%ld>.",
1594 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1595 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1596 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).KeySize );
1597 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1598
1599 DoNotChangeKeyValues = true;
1600
1601 if (KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated==0){
1602 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated = cst_ZRF_default_allocation;
1603
1604 ZChangeRecord wChgRecAll(ZFGC_ChgAlloc);
1605 wChgRecAll.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1606 wChgRecAll.setAnteU64(size_t(0L));
1607 wChgRecAll.setPostU64(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated );
1608 wChgRecAll.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1609 ChangeLog.push(wChgRecAll);
1610 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value <Key Allocated blocks> for key <%s> has been defaulted to <%ld>.Logging change for this value.",
1611 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1612 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1613 cst_ZRF_default_allocation);
1614 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1615
1616 }
1617
1618 ZChangeRecord wChgRecAllSiz(ZFGC_ChgAlloc);
1619 wChgRecAllSiz.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1620 wChgRecAllSiz.setAnteU64(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize);
1621 wChgRecAllSiz.setPostU64(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated * wValue );
1622 wChgRecAllSiz.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1623 ChangeLog.push(wChgRecAllSiz);
1624
1625 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize = KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated * wValue;
1626 wStr.sprintf("%ld",KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize);
1627 KeyTBv->ItemModel->item(pItem->row(),cst_KeyAllocSizeCol)->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1628 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value <Key Allocation Size> for key <%s> has been computed to <%ld>.Logging change for this value.",
1629 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1630 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1631 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize );
1632// plainTextEdit->appendPlainText(wStr.toCChar());
1633 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1634
1635 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentSize = KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentQuota * wValue;
1636 wStr.sprintf("%ld",KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentSize);
1637 KeyTBv->ItemModel->item(pItem->row(),cst_KeyExtentSizeCol)->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1638
1639 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value <Key Extent Size> for key <%s> has been computed to <%ld>. Logging change for this value.",
1640 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1641 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1642 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentSize );
1643 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1644
1645 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1646 return ;
1647 }// cst_KeySizeCol
1648
1649 case cst_KeyAllocCol: {
1650
1651 wStr = pItem->text().toUtf8().data();
1652 wValue=getValueFromString<size_t>(wStr);
1653
1654 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1655 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_ChgAlloc);
1656 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1657 wChgRec.setAnteU64(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated);
1658 wChgRec.setPostU64(wValue);
1659 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1660 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1661
1662 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated = wValue;
1663
1664 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value <Allocation> for key <%s> has been changed to <%ld>.",
1665 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1666 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1667 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).Allocated );
1668
1669 DoNotChangeKeyValues = true;
1670
1671 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize = KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).KeySize * wValue;
1672 wStr.sprintf("%ld",KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize);
1673 KeyTBv->ItemModel->item(pItem->row(),cst_KeyAllocSizeCol)->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1674
1675 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value <Key Allocation Size> for key <%s> has been computed to <%ld>.",
1676 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1677 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1678 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).AllocatedSize);
1679 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1680
1681 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1682
1683 return ;
1684 } //cst_KeyAllocCol
1685 case cst_KeyExtentQuotaCol: {
1686
1687 wStr = pItem->text().toUtf8().data();
1688 wValue=getValueFromString<size_t>(wStr);
1689
1690 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
1691 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_ChgExtent);
1692 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).IndexName);
1693 wChgRec.setAnteU64(KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentQuota);
1694 wChgRec.setPostU64(wValue);
1695 wChgRec.setIndexRank (pItem->row());
1696 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
1697
1698 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentQuota = wValue;
1699 wName="Extent quota";
1700 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value %s for key <%s> has been changed to <%ld>.",
1701 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1702 wName,
1703 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1704 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentQuota );
1705 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1706
1707 DoNotChangeKeyValues = true;
1708
1709 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentSize = KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).KeySize * wValue;
1710 wStr.sprintf("%ld",KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentSize);
1711 KeyTBv->ItemModel->item(pItem->row(),cst_KeyExtentSizeCol)->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1712
1713 wName="Extent quota size";
1714 wStr.sprintf( "%s Value %s for key <%s> has been computed to <%ld>.",
1715 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1716 wName,
1717 wMainKeyItem->text().toUtf8().data(),
1718 KeyValues->Tab(pItem->row()).ExtentSize);
1719// plainTextEdit->appendPlainText(wStr.toCChar());
1720 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
1721
1722 DoNotChangeKeyValues = false;
1723
1724 return ;
1725 } // cst_KeyExtentQuotaCol
1726
1727 default:
1728// plainTextEdit->appendPlainText("Modifying this column is not authorized.");
1729 ComLog->appendText("Modifying this column is not authorized.");
1730 return;
1731 }// switch
1732
1733 return;
1734}//FileGenerateDLg::GuessItemChanged

1737FileGenerateMWn::Compute() {
1738 ZArray<utf8VaryingString> wWarnedFields;
1739 MeanRecordSize=0;
1740 utf8VaryingString wStr;
1741
1742// MeanRecordSize += sizeof(uint64_t); /* user record size */ // no --deprecated--
1743
1744 /* size of key section : address array */
1745
1746 MeanRecordSize += sizeof(uint32_t); /* number of key addresses */
1747 MeanRecordSize += sizeof(zaddress_type) * DictionaryFile->KeyDic.count() ;
1748
1749 /* bitset size */
1750 ZBitset wBS;
1751 wBS._allocate(DictionaryFile->count() );
1752 MeanRecordSize += wBS.getURFSize();
1753
1754 MeanRecordSize += sizeof(uint64_t); /* URF Data size */
1755
1756 for (long wi=0 ; wi < DictionaryFile->count() ; wi++) {
1757 MeanRecordSize += DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).HeaderSize;
1758 MeanRecordSize += DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).UniversalSize;
1759 if ((DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).ZType & ZType_VaryingMask) || (DictionaryFile->Tab(wi).UniversalSize==0)) {
1760 }
1761 } // for
1762
1763 bool wNotGuessed = false;
1764 for (int wi=0;wi < GuessTBv->ItemModel->rowCount();wi++) {
1765 QVariant wV = GuessTBv->ItemModel->item(wi,3)->data(Qt::UserRole);
1766 if (wV.isValid()) {
1767 size_t wValue = wV.value<size_t>();
1768 MeanRecordSize += wValue;
1769 }
1770 else {
1771 QStandardItem* wItem = GuessTBv->ItemModel->item(wi,0);
1772
1773 ComLog->appendTextColor(QColor(),WarnedQCl, "%s-W-INVSIZ Size value for field <%s> has not been guessed and remains invalid.",
1774 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
1775 wItem->text().toUtf8().data());
1776 wNotGuessed=true;
1777 }
1778 }// for
1779
1780 if (wNotGuessed)
1781 HideGuessBTn->setIcon(CrossRedPXm);
1782 else
1783 HideGuessBTn->setIcon(CrossBluePXm);
1784
1785 MeanRecordSize += sizeof(uint32_t);
1786
1787 wStr.sprintf("%ld",MeanRecordSize);
1788 MeanSizeLEd->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1789
1790 AllocatedSize = MeanRecordSize*AllocatedBlocks;
1791 wStr.sprintf("%ld",MeanRecordSize*AllocatedBlocks);
1792 AllocatedSizeLEd->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1793
1794 wStr.sprintf("%ld",(MeanRecordSize*AllocatedBlocks)+1024);
1795 InitialSizeLEd->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1796
1797 ExtentQuotaSize = MeanRecordSize*ExtentQuota;
1798 wStr.sprintf("%ld",ExtentQuotaSize);
1799 ExtentQuotaSizeLEd->setText(wStr.toCChar());
1800}

2169void
2170FileGenerateMWn::KeyDelete() {
2171 QModelIndex wIdx= KeyTBv->currentIndex();
2172 if (!wIdx.isValid())
2173 return;
2174 long wI= long(wIdx.row());
2175
2176 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
2177 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_KeyDelete);
2178 wChgRec.setChangeKey(KeyValues->Tab(wI).IndexName);
2179
2180 wChgRec.setIndexRank (wIdx.row());
2181 wChgRec.setAnteKeyData(KeyValues->Tab(wI)); /* store deleted key data (post remains nullptr) */
2182
2183 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
2184
2185 if (DeletedKeyValues==nullptr)
2186 DeletedKeyValues = new ZArray<KeyData> ;
2187
2188 DeletedKeyValues->push(KeyValues->Tab(wI));
2189
2190
2191 KeyTBv->ItemModel->removeRow(int(wI));
2192
2193 if (DictionaryFile!=nullptr) {
2194 if (DictionaryFile->KeyDic.count()>wI) {
2195 ComLog->appendText("Corresponding key named <%s> is been removed from dictionary.",
2196 DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wI]->DicKeyName.toString());
2197 DictionaryFile->KeyDic.erase(wI);
2198 }
2199 else
2200 ComLog->appendText("Cannot remove from dictionary key named <%s>.",
2201 KeyValues->Tab(wI).IndexName.toString());
2202
2203 }
2204
2205 KeyValues->erase(wI);
2206 return;
2207}

2209void
2210FileGenerateMWn::KeyAppendRaw() {
2211 if (KeyValues==nullptr)
2212 KeyValues = new ZArray<KeyData> ;
2213
2214
2215 KeyData wKD;
2216 wKD.IndexName = "New key";
2217 ZKeyHeaderRow wKHR;
2218
2219 ZKeyDLg* wKeyDLg = new ZKeyDLg(this);
2220 while (true) {
2221 int wRet=wKeyDLg->exec();
2222 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
2223 return;
2224 wKHR = wKeyDLg->get();
2225 if (wKHR.DicKeyName.isEmpty()){
2226 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("New raw key",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
2227 "Key name cannot be null");
2228 continue;
2229 }
2230 long wKI=-1;
2231 for (long wi=0;wi < KeyValues->count();wi++) {
2232 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName==wKHR.DicKeyName) {
2233 wKI=wi;
2234 break;
2235 }
2236 }
2237 if (wKI<0){
2238 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("New raw key",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
2239 "Key name <%s> already exists."
2240 "A key/index name must be unique.",wKHR.DicKeyName.toString());
2241 continue;
2242 }
2243 break;
2244 }//while true
2245
2246 wKD.IndexName = wKHR.DicKeyName ;
2247 wKD.Duplicates = wKHR.Duplicates ;
2248 wKD.KeySize = size_t(wKHR.KeyGuessedSize);
2249
2250 long wR=KeyValues->push(wKD);
2251 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
2252 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_KeyRawAppend);
2253 wChgRec.setChangeKey(wKD.IndexName);
2254 wChgRec.setPostKeyData(wKD);
2255 wChgRec.setIndexRank (wR);
2256 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
2257
2258 QList<QStandardItem*> wKeyRow = formatKeyRow(wKD);
2259 KeyTBv->ItemModel->appendRow(wKeyRow);
2260}

2303
2304ZStatus
2305FileGenerateMWn::KeyAppendFromZMFDic(const ZMFDictionary* pDic) {
2306 ZKeyListDLg* wKLDLg=new ZKeyListDLg(this);
2307 wKLDLg->initLayout();
2308 ZStatus wSt=wKLDLg->displayKeyDictionaries(pDic);
2309 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2310 return wSt;
2311
2312 wKLDLg->show();
2313 int wRet=wKLDLg->exec();
2314 if (wRet==QDialog::Accepted) {
2315 KeyData wKD;
2316 wKD = wKLDLg->getKeyData();
2317 if (KeyValues==nullptr) {
2318 KeyValues=new zbs::ZArray<KeyData>;
2319 }
2320 /* generate index file root name */
2321 wKD.IndexRootName = generateIndexRootName(RootName,wKD.IndexName);
2322
2323 if (wKD.KeySize==0) {
2324 ComLog->appendTextColor(QColor(),WarnedQCl, "%s-W-KEYZERSZ Appended Key <%s> has KeySize equal to Zero and must be guessed.\n"
2325 "All size values are computed from this single value and will be set to zero.",
2326 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
2327 wKD.IndexName.toString());
2328 }
2329
2330 /* compute size values */
2331 wKD.Allocated = cst_ZRF_default_allocation;
2332 wKD.ExtentQuota = cst_ZRF_default_extentquota;
2333 wKD.AllocatedSize = wKD.Allocated * wKD.KeySize;
2334 if (wKD.AllocatedSize==0) {
2335 wKD.AllocatedSize = 150; /* a default value as another */
2336 ComLog->appendText("Key creation: Defaulting AllocatedSize to 150 ");
2337 }
2338 wKD.ExtentSize = wKD.ExtentQuota * wKD.KeySize;
2339 if (wKD.ExtentSize==0) {
2340 wKD.ExtentSize = 150; /* a default value as another */
2341 ComLog->appendText("Key creation: Defaulting ExtentQuota to 150 ");
2342 }
2343 /* then store new key from dic */
2344 long wR=KeyValues->push(wKD);
2345 /* first setup change log with values ex-ante and ex-post */
2346 ZChangeRecord wChgRec(ZFGC_KeyDicAppend);
2347 wChgRec.setChangeKey(wKD.IndexName);
2348 wChgRec.setPostKeyData(wKD);
2349 wChgRec.setIndexRank (wR);
2350 ChangeLog.push(wChgRec);
2351
2352 ComLog->appendText("Created ChangeLog record : new key <%s> waiting for creation.",
2353 wKD.IndexName.toString());
2354
2355 /* display key in key list */
2356 QList<QStandardItem*> wKeyRow = formatKeyRow(wKD);
2357 KeyTBv->ItemModel->appendRow(wKeyRow);
2358
2359 for (int wi=0; wi < KeyTBv->ItemModel->columnCount(); wi++)
2360 KeyTBv->resizeColumnToContents(wi);
2361 for (int wi=0; wi < KeyTBv->ItemModel->rowCount(); wi++)
2362 KeyTBv->resizeRowToContents(wi);
2363
2364 }
2365 delete wKLDLg;
2366 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2367}
2368
2369bool FileGenerateMWn::setupFromZmfFile() {
2370 utf8VaryingString wStr;
2371
2372 QFileDialog wFDLg((QWidget*)this,QObject::tr("Search master file","FileGenerateDLg"),
2373 GeneralParameters.getWorkDirectory().toCChar(),
2374 "ZMF files (*.zmf);;All files (*.*)");
2375
2376 wFDLg.setLabelText(QFileDialog::Accept, QObject::tr("Select","FileGenerateDLg"));
2377 wFDLg.setLabelText(QFileDialog::Reject, QObject::tr("Cancel","FileGenerateDLg"));
2378
2379 wFDLg.setOptions(QFileDialog::ReadOnly);
2380 wFDLg.setFileMode(QFileDialog::ExistingFiles);
2381 wFDLg.setDirectory(GeneralParameters.getWorkDirectory().toCChar());
2382 int wRet=wFDLg.exec();
2383
2384 if ((wRet==QDialog::Rejected) ||(wFDLg.selectedFiles().isEmpty()))
2385 return false;
2386

2556
2557ZStatus
2558FileGenerateMWn::applyChangesZmf(bool pBackup) {
2559 ZStatus wSt;
2560 zbs::ZArray<utf8VaryingString> wIndexToRebuild;
2561
2562 if ((MasterFile==nullptr) || (!MasterFile->isOpen())) {
2563 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Apply changes",Severity_Error,&ErrorLog,nullptr,"Master file must be open to be changed");
2564 return ZS_FILENOTOPEN;
2565 }
2566
2567 _refresh(); /* update some booleans like GrabFreeSpace */
2568
2569 if (ValuesControl()) {
2570 return ZS_INVPARAMS;
2571 }
2572 wSt=MasterFile->Dictionary->save_xml(true);
2573// DictionaryFile->save_xml(true);
2574 wSt=MasterFile->writeControlBlocks();
2575
2576 int wModif=0,wKeyModif=0,wKeyCreated=0,wKeyDeleted=0,wKeyErrored=0,wRebuildErrored=0;
2577
2578 utf8VaryingString wStr;
2579
2580 ComLog->appendText("Applying changes to file <%s>.", MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
2581
2582 if (MasterFile->getOpenMode()!=ZRF_All) {
2583// if (MasterFile->getOpenMode()!=ZRF_NotOpen) {
2584 ComLog->appendText(" File is open in mode <%s>. Closing file then reopenning it.\n",
2585 decode_ZRFMode(MasterFile->getOpenMode()));
2586 MasterFile->zclose();
2587// }
2588
2589 ComLog->appendText("re-openning file <%s> with mode ZRF_All | ZRF_TypeRegardless.", MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
2590
2591 wSt=MasterFile->zopen(ZRF_All| ZRF_TypeRegardless);
2592 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2593 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Master file change",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
2594 " Error while opening master file <%s> \n"
2595 " status <%s>",
2596 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
2597 decode_ZStatus(wSt));
2598
2599 ComLog->appendTextColor( ErroredQCl," Error while opening master file <%s> \nException content follows:\n%s",
2600 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
2601 ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toString());
2602 return wSt;
2603 }
2604 } //if (MasterFile->getOpenMode()!=ZRF_All)
2605
2606
2607 /* backup of files */
2608 if (pBackup) {
2609 ComLog->appendText("Backing up of components for file %s",MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
2610
2611 utf8VaryingString wBckset = MasterFile->getURIContent().getRootname() + utf8VaryingString("_bck");
2612 uriString wBckDir = MasterFile->getURIContent().getDirectoryPath();
2613 wBckDir.addConditionalDirectoryDelimiter();
2614 wSt=MasterFile->backupAll(wBckDir,wBckset);
2615 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2616 ComLog->appendText("Cannot backup files ");
2617 ComLog->appendText(ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage());
2618 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Backup files",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
2619 ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toCChar());
2620 ComLog->appendTextColor(QColor(), ErroredQCl,"Cannot backup files.\nException content follows:\n%s",
2621 ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toString());
2622 return wSt;
2623 }
2624
2625 ComLog->appendText("Backed up all files of <%s> ",MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
2626 }
2627
2628 /* effective apply changes */
2629
2630 ComLog->appendText("Applying changes to file <%s>",MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
2631
2632 if (MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockTargetSize != MeanRecordSize) {
2633 wStr.sprintf("Changing BlockTargetSize from %ld to %ld.",
2634 MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockTargetSize,MeanRecordSize );
2635 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2636
2637 MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockTargetSize = MeanRecordSize ;
2638 wModif ++;
2639 }
2640
2641 if (MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota != ExtentQuota) {
2642 wStr.sprintf("Changing BlockExtentQuota from %ld to %ld.",
2643 MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota,ExtentQuota );
2644 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2645
2646 MasterFile->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota = ExtentQuota ;
2647 wModif ++;
2648 }
2649
2650 if (MasterFile->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace != GrabFreeSpace) {
2651 wStr.sprintf("Changing GrabFreeSpace from %s to %s.",
2652 MasterFile->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace?"true":"false",GrabFreeSpace?"true":"false" );
2653 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2654 if (!pBackup)
2655 MasterFile->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace = GrabFreeSpace ;
2656 }
2657
2658 if (MasterFile->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking != HighWaterMarking) {
2659 wStr.sprintf("Changing HighwaterMarking from %s to %s.",
2660 MasterFile->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking?"true":"false",HighWaterMarking?"true":"false" );
2661 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2662
2663 MasterFile->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking = HighWaterMarking ;
2664 wModif ++;
2665 }
2666
2667 if (MasterFile->hasJournal() != Journaling) {
2668 wStr.sprintf("Changing Journaling from %s to %s.",
2669 MasterFile->hasJournal()?"true":"false",Journaling?"true":"false" );
2670 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2671 /* put journaling on or off according Journaling */
2672 if (Journaling) {
2673 MasterFile->setJournalingOn();
2674 ComLog->appendText("Journaling started.");
2675 }
2676 else {
2677 MasterFile->setJournalingOff();
2678 ComLog->appendText("Journaling stopped.");
2679 }
2680
2681 wModif ++;
2682 } // Journaling
2683
2684
2685 ComLog->appendText("Processing key modifications.");
2686
2687 for (long wChgIdx=0; wChgIdx < ChangeLog.count();wChgIdx++) {
2688 ZChangeRecord wChgRec = ChangeLog[wChgIdx];
2689 const char* wName="<no field>";
2690 long wKeyRow = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getIndexRank();
2691 ComLog->appendText("Found change log code <%s> index key rank <%ld>",
2692 decode_ZFGC(ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getChangeCode()),
2693 ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getIndexRank() );
2694 switch(ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getChangeCode()) {
2695
2696 case ZFGC_ChgKeySize : {
2697 size_t wNewKeySize = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostU64();
2698 wName="KeyGuessedSize";
2699 ComLog->appendText("%s changed %s field from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2700 wName,
2701 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getURIContent().toString(),
2702 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->KeyGuessedSize,
2703 wNewKeySize);
2704 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->KeyGuessedSize = wNewKeySize ;
2705
2706 wKeyModif++;
2707 break;
2708 }
2709 case ZFGC_ChgExtent : {
2710 size_t wNewExtent = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostU64();
2711 wName="Extent quota";
2712 ComLog->appendText("%s changed %s field from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2713 wName,
2714 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getURIContent().toString(),
2715 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota,
2716 wNewExtent);
2717 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->BlockExtentQuota = wNewExtent ;
2718 wKeyModif++;
2719 break;
2720 }
2721 case ZFGC_ChgAlloc : {
2722 size_t wNewAlloc = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostU64();
2723 wName="Allocated blocks";
2724 wStr.sprintf("%s changed %s field from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2725 wName,
2726 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getURIContent().toString(),
2727 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->AllocatedBlocks,
2728 wNewAlloc);
2729 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2730 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->AllocatedBlocks = wNewAlloc ;
2731 wKeyModif++;
2732 break;
2733 }
2734
2735 case ZFGC_ChgDuplicate : {
2736 ZSort_Type wNewDup = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostZSortType();
2737 wName="Duplicates";
2738 wStr.sprintf("%s changed %s field from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2739 wName,
2740 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getURIContent().toString(),
2741 decode_ZST( MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->Duplicates),
2742 wNewDup?"true":"false");
2743 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2744 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->Duplicates = wNewDup ;
2745 wKeyModif++;
2746 break;
2747 }
2748 case ZFGC_ChgGrab: {
2749 bool wNewGrab = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostBool();
2750 wName="GrabFreeSpace";
2751 wStr.sprintf("%s changed %s field from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2752 wName,
2753 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getURIContent().toString(),
2754 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace?"true":"false",
2755 wNewGrab?"true":"false");
2756 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2757 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->GrabFreeSpace = wNewGrab;
2758 wKeyModif++;
2759 break;
2760 }
2761 case ZFGC_ChgHigh: {
2762 bool wNewHigh = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostBool();
2763 wName="Highwater marking";
2764 wStr.sprintf("%s changed %s field from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2765 wName,
2766 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getURIContent().toString(),
2767 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking?"true":"false",
2768 wNewHigh?"true":"false");
2769 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
2770 MasterFile->IndexTable[wKeyRow]->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking = wNewHigh;
2771 wKeyModif++;
2772 break;
2773 }
2774
2775 case ZFGC_INameChange: {
2776
2777 long wIndexRank=ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getIndexRank();
2778
2779 utf8VaryingString wZMFRootName,wIndexRootName,wComplement,wOldKeyName,wNewKeyName;
2780 uriString wNewIndexURI;
2781 wOldKeyName = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getAnteString();
2782 wNewKeyName = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostString();
2783
2784 wComplement = "Changing index name induces a change in related index file name accordingly.";
2785
2786 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2BHtml("Change index name",Severity_Question,
2787 "Do not change","Change",
2788 nullptr,&wComplement,
2789 "Index file <%s>\n"
2790 "About to change index file name \n"
2791 "from <%s> to <%s>.\n\n"
2792 "<table>"
2793 "<tr><td> Abandon operation and keep index name</td> <td><b>Do not Change</b></td> </tr>"
2794 "<tr><td> Change index name and rename index file</td> <td><b>Change</b></td> </tr>"
2795 "</table>",
2796 MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->getURIContent().toString(),
2797 wOldKeyName.toString(),
2798 wNewKeyName.toString());
2799 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected) {
2800 ComLog->appendText("%s index name change from <%s> to <%s> has been rejected.",
2801 MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->getURIContent().toString(),
2802 wOldKeyName.toString(),
2803 wNewKeyName.toString());
2804 continue;
2805 }
2806 uriString wFormerIndexURI,wNewIndex;
2807 zmode_type wMode=ZRF_NotOpen;
2808 if (MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->isOpen()) {
2809 wMode = MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->getMode();
2810 }
2811 else {
2812 wSt=MasterFile->zopenIndexFile(wIndexRank,ZRF_All);
2813 }
2814
2815 wFormerIndexURI = MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->getURIContent();
2816
2817 wZMFRootName=MasterFile->getURIContent().getRootname();
2818
2819 wSt=generateIndexURI(wNewIndexURI,MasterFile->getURIContent(),MasterFile->IndexFilePath,wNewIndex);
2820
2821 wSt=wFormerIndexURI.rename(wNewIndexURI);
2822// wSt=renameFile(wFormerIndexURI,wNewIndexURI);
2823 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2824
2825 ComLog->appendText(ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage());
2826 return ZException.last().Status;
2827 }
2828
2829 ComLog->appendText("%s renamed index file from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2830 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
2831 wFormerIndexURI.toString(),
2832 wNewIndexURI.toString());
2833
2834 ComLog->appendText("%s changed index name from <%ld> to <%ld>.",
2835 wName,
2836 MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->getURIContent().toString(),
2837 wOldKeyName.toString(),
2838 wNewKeyName.toString());
2839 MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->IndexName = wNewKeyName;
2840
2841 if (wMode!=ZRF_NotOpen) {
2842 MasterFile->zopenIndexFile(wIndexRank,wMode);
2843 }
2844 wKeyModif++;
2845 break;
2846 } //ZFGC_INameChange
2847
2848 case ZFGC_KeyDelete: {
2849 utf8VaryingString wKeyName = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getChangeKey();
2850 long wIndexRank=ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getIndexRank();
2851
2852 uriString wURIIndex = MasterFile->IndexTable[wIndexRank]->getURIContent();
2853
2854 ComLog->appendText("Removing index file %s.", wURIIndex.toString() );
2855 wKeyModif++;
2856
2857 wKeyDeleted ++;
2858 wSt=wURIIndex.remove();
2859// wSt =removeFile(wURIIndex.toCChar());
2860 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2861 utf8VaryingString wComplement = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage();
2862 int wRet = ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2BHtml("Index file deletion",Severity_Error,"Abort","Continue",
2863 &ErrorLog,&wComplement,
2864 "Cannot remove index file <%s>\n\n"
2865 "<table>"
2866 "<tr><td> terminate processing of changes</td> <td><b>Abort</b></td></tr>"
2867 "<tr><td> continue anyway</td> <td><b>Continue</b></td></tr>"
2868 "</table>"
2869 ,wURIIndex.toString());
2870 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
2871 return wSt;
2872 }
2873 break;
2874 } // ZFGC_KeyDelete
2875
2876 case ZFGC_KeyDicAppend:
2877 case ZFGC_KeyRawAppend: {
2878
2879 /* A created key has mandatorily a name (unique name) whatever its data has been set to */
2880
2881 KeyData wKD = ChangeLog[wChgIdx].getPostKeyData();
2882 bool wSkip=false;
2883 for (long wj=0; wj < MasterFile->IndexTable.count(); wj++) {
2884 if (wKD.IndexName == MasterFile->IndexTable[wj]->IndexName) {
2885 ComLog->appendText("Index key <%s> already exists in file <%s>.Skipping index key creation.",
2886 wKD.IndexName.toString(),
2887 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
2888 wSkip=true;
2889 wKeyErrored ++;
2890 }
2891 }// for
2892 if (wSkip)
2893 continue;
2894
2895 // KeyValues->push(wKD);
2896
2897 long wOutRank;
2898 wSt = MasterFile->_createRawIndexDet(wOutRank,
2899 wKD.IndexName,
2900 uint32_t(wKD.KeySize),
2901 wKD.Duplicates,
2902 long(wKD.Allocated),
2903 long(wKD.ExtentQuota),
2904 zsize_type(wKD.AllocatedSize),
2905 wKD.HighwaterMarking,
2906 wKD.GrabFreeSpace,
2907 true,&ErrorLog);
2908
2909 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
2910 utf8VaryingString wComplement = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage();
2911 int wRet = ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2BHtml("Index file creation",Severity_Error,"Abort","Continue",
2912 &ErrorLog,&wComplement,
2913 "Cannot create index file for index key <%s>\n\n"
2914 "<table>"
2915 "<tr><td> terminate processing of changes</td> <td><b>Abort</b></td></tr>"
2916 "<tr><td> continue anyway</td> <td><b>Continue</b></td></tr>"
2917 "</table>"
2918 ,wKD.IndexName.toString());
2919 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
2920 return wSt;
2921 }
2922 else
2923 wIndexToRebuild.push(wKD.IndexName);
2924 wKeyModif++;
2925 break;
2926 }
2927 default:
2928 break;
2929 }// switch
2930 } // for
2931
2932 ComLog->appendText("%s Writting changes to files.",ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString());
2933 wSt=MasterFile->_writeAllHeaders();
2934 ComLog->appendText("%s Done.",ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString());
2935
2936 if (wIndexToRebuild.count()!=0){
2937 if (MasterFile->Dictionary==nullptr) {
2938 utf8VaryingString wStr;
2939 for (long wi=0 ; wi < wIndexToRebuild.count() ; wi++) {
2940 wStr += wIndexToRebuild[wi].toString() ;
2941 wStr += "\n";
2942 }
2943 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Index rebuild",Severity_Information,nullptr,nullptr,
2944 "Some index keys require to be rebuilt.\n"
2945 "Following index keys have to be rebuilt.\n"
2946 "%s",wStr.toString());
2947 ComLog->appendText("Some index keys require to be rebuilt.\n"
2948 "Following index keys have to be rebuilt.\n"
2949 "%s",wStr.toString());
2950
2951 return MasterFile->_writeAllHeaders();
2952 }// if (MasterFile->Dictionary==nullptr)
2953
2954 utf8VaryingString wStr;
2955 for (long wi=0 ; wi < wIndexToRebuild.count() ; wi++) {
2956 int wRet= ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B( "Index rebuild",Severity_Question,
2957 "Skip","Rebuild",
2958 nullptr,nullptr,
2959 "Index key <%s> has to be rebuilt.\n",wIndexToRebuild[wi].toString());
2960 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected) {
2961 ComLog->appendText("Index key <%s> needs to be rebuilt.\n",wIndexToRebuild[wi].toString());
2962 continue;
2963 }
2964 long wIRank =-1;
2965 for (long wj=0 ; wj < MasterFile->IndexTable.count();wj++ )
2966 if (MasterFile->IndexTable[wj]->IndexName==wIndexToRebuild[wi]){
2967 wIRank=wj;
2968 break;
2969 }
2970 if (wIRank<0) {
2971 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Index key rebuild",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
2972 "Index key to be rebuilt <%s> cannot be found.\n"
2973 "Rebuild action is skipped.",MasterFile->IndexTable[wi]->IndexName.toString());
2974 wRebuildErrored ++;
2975 continue;
2976 }
2977 ComLog->appendText("Rebuilding index key <%s> using embedded dictionary",MasterFile->IndexTable[wIRank]->IndexName.toString());
2978 wSt=rebuildIndex(wIRank);
2979 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS){
2980 if (wSt==ZS_EMPTY) {
2981 ComLog->appendTextColor(ErroredQCl,"%s-W-EMPTY Index key name <%s> cannot be rebuilt because file is empty.\n",
2982 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
2983 MasterFile->IndexTable[wIRank]->IndexName.toString());
2984 }
2985 else {
2986 wStr=ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage();
2987 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Index key rebuild",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wStr,
2988 "Index key rebuilt process has been errored.\n"
2989 "Index key name <%s>",MasterFile->IndexTable[wIRank]->IndexName.toString());
2990
2991 ComLog->appendTextColor(ErroredQCl,"%s-E-ERRBLD Index key name <%s> rebuilt process has been errored.\n"
2992 "Exception follows:\n%s",
2993 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
2994 MasterFile->IndexTable[wIRank]->IndexName.toString(),
2995 wStr.toString());
2996 wRebuildErrored++;
2997 }
2998 continue;
2999 }
3000 ComLog->appendText("Index key rebuilt process has successfully completed.\n"
3001 "Index key name <%s>",MasterFile->IndexTable[wIRank]->IndexName.toString());
3002 }//for (long wi=0 ; wi < wIndexToRebuild.count() ; wi++)
3003 } //if (wIndexToRebuild.count()!=0)
3004 else
3005 ComLog->appendText("No index to rebuild.");
3006
3007 ComLog->appendText("Deleting change log content");
3008 int wi=0;
3009 while (ChangeLog.count() > 0) {
3010 ChangeLog.pop();
3011 wi++;
3012 }
3013
3014
3015 ComLog->appendHtml("<br>"
3016 "Changed file <%s><br>"
3017 "<table border=\"1\""
3018 "<tr><td>Master file parameter changes</td> <td>%d</td> </tr>"
3019 "<tr><td>Index key changes</td> <td>%d</td> </tr>"
3020 "<tr><td>Created index keys</td> <td>%d</td> </tr>"
3021 "<tr><td>Suppressed index keys</td> <td>%d</td> </tr>"
3022 "<tr><td>Errors on key change </td> <td>%d</td> </tr>"
3023 "<tr><td>Errors on key rebuild process</td> <td>%d</td> </tr>"
3024 "</table>",
3025 wModif,wKeyModif,
3026 wKeyCreated, wKeyDeleted,
3027 wKeyErrored, wRebuildErrored);
3028
3029
3030 ComLog->appendText("\nEnd of change log processing.");
3031 return wSt;
3032} // applyChangesZmf

3035FileGenerateMWn::indexRebuildFromMenu(){
3036 ZKeyListDLg* wKLDLg=new ZKeyListDLg(this);
3037 wKLDLg->initLayout();
3038 ZStatus wSt=wKLDLg->displayKeyDictionaries(MasterFile->Dictionary);
3039 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3040 return wSt;
3041
3042 wKLDLg->show();
3043 int wRet=wKLDLg->exec();
3044 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
3045 return ZS_REJECTED;
3046
3047 KeyData wKD;
3048 wKD = wKLDLg->getKeyData();
3049 long wIdx=-1;
3050 for (long wi=0;wi < MasterFile->Dictionary->KeyDic.count();wi++) {
3051 if (MasterFile->Dictionary->KeyDic[wi]->DicKeyName==wKD.IndexName){
3052 wIdx=wi;
3053 break;
3054 }
3055 }
3056 if (wIdx<0) {
3057 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Rebuild index key",Severity_Error,"Selected index key named <%s> cannot be found.\n"
3058 "It must have been deleted meanwhile by another thread.",wKD.IndexName.toString());
3059 return ZS_NOTFOUND;
3060 }
3061
3062 wSt=rebuildIndex(wIdx);
3063 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3064 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Rebuild index key",Severity_Error,"Errors were encountered while rebuilding index key <%s>.\n",
3065 wKD.IndexName.toString());
3066 return wSt;
3067 }
3068
3069 return ZS_SUCCESS;
3070}

3072
3073ZStatus
3074FileGenerateMWn::rebuildIndex(long pIndexRankToRebuild) {
3075
3076/* index rebuild progress window setup */
3077
3078 ProgressMWn=new ZMFProgressMWn("Index key rebuild",this,false);
3079
3080 ProgressMWn->advanceSetupCallBack(MasterFile->getRecordCount(),"Index key rebuild");
3081 ProgressMWn->setDescBudy("Index key name");
3082 ProgressMWn->setDescText(MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName);
3083
3084 ProgressMWn->show();
3085
3086 /* rebuild process*/
3087
3088 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
3089 utf8VaryingString wStr;
3090 ZDataBuffer wRecord, wKeyRecord;
3091 zaddress_type wZMFAddress;
3092 ZIndexItem* wIndexItem=nullptr;
3093 long wCurrentRank=0L,wRecordCount=0L;
3094 zmode_type wMasterOpenMode, wIndexOpenMode;
3095
3096 wMasterOpenMode = MasterFile->getMode();
3097 if ((MasterFile->getMode()&ZRF_All)!=ZRF_All) {
3098 ZException.setMessage("ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex",ZS_FILENOTOPEN,Severity_Error,
3099 "File is open in mode %s. It must be open with access mode ZRF_All.",decode_ZRFMode(MasterFile->getMode()));
3100 ComLog->appendText("ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex-E-INVMOD File is open in mode %s. It must be open with access mode ZRF_All.",decode_ZRFMode(MasterFile->getMode()));
3101 ProgressMWn->close(); /* is deleteonclose */
3102 return ZS_MODEINVALID;
3103 }
3104 wRecordCount = MasterFile->getRecordCount();
3105 if (MasterFile->getRecordCount()==0) {
3106 ZException.setMessage("ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex",ZS_FILENOTOPEN,Severity_Error,
3107 "rebuilding index key <%s> - Master file is empty.\n",
3108 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3109 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString());
3110
3111 ComLog->appendTextColor( WarnedQCl, "%s-W rebuilding index key <%s> - Master file is empty.\n",
3112 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3113 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString());
3114 ProgressMWn->close(); /* is deleteonclose */
3115 return ZS_EMPTY;
3116
3117 }
3118
3119 if (pIndexRankToRebuild >= MasterFile->IndexTable.count()) {
3120 ZException.setMessage("ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex",ZS_OUTBOUND,Severity_Error,
3121 "Invalid index rank <%ld> while expecting one of [0,%ld[.",pIndexRankToRebuild,MasterFile->IndexTable.count());
3122 ComLog->appendText("ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex-E-INVRANK Invalid index rank <%ld> while expecting one of [0,%ld[.",pIndexRankToRebuild,MasterFile->IndexTable.count());
3123
3124 ProgressMWn->close(); /* is deleteonclose */
3125 return ZS_INVTYPE;
3126 }
3127
3128
3129 ComLog->appendText("%s- rebuilding index key <%s> - clearing index file.",
3130 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3131 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString());
3132
3133
3134 ComLog->appendText("%s- rebuilding index key <%s> - clearing index file.",
3135 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3136 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString());
3137
3138 wSt=MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->zclearFile(-1,MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->getFCB()->HighwaterMarking,&ErrorLog);
3139 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS){
3140 ProgressMWn->close(); /* is deleteonclose */
3141 return wSt;
3142 }
3143
3144 ComLog->appendText("%s- rebuilding index key <%s> - populating index file.",
3145 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3146 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString());
3147
3148
3149 /* browse all master file records, extract key and feed index file */
3150 wSt=MasterFile->zgetWAddress(wRecord,0L,wZMFAddress);
3151 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS){
3152 goto rebuildIndexError;
3153 }
3154 while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) {
3155 wSt=MasterFile->extractKeyValues(wRecord,wKeyRecord,pIndexRankToRebuild, &ErrorLog);
3156 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3157 goto rebuildIndexError;
3158 wSt=MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->_addRawKeyValue_Prepare(wIndexItem,wKeyRecord,wZMFAddress);
3159 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3160 goto rebuildIndexError;
3161 wSt=MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->_rawKeyValue_Commit(wIndexItem);
3162 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
3163 goto rebuildIndexError;
3164
3165 ProgressMWn->AdvanceDisplay(wCurrentRank);
3166
3167 wSt=MasterFile->zgetNextWAddress(wRecord,wCurrentRank,wZMFAddress);
3168 } // while (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS)
3169
3170 if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
3171 wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
3172
3173
3174
3175 if (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) {
3176 ComLog->appendText("%s- rebuilding index key <%s> - rebuild process done successfully.\n"
3177 " writting all headers to files.",
3178 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3179 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString());
3180
3181 QApplication::processEvents();
3182
3183 wSt = MasterFile->_writeAllHeaders();
3184 }
3185 if (wSt==ZS_SUCCESS) {
3186 return wSt;
3187 }
3188
3189// IndexRebuildMWn->deleteLater();
3190
3191rebuildIndexError:
3192 ProgressMWn->setDone(wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS);
3193
3194 if (ZException.count()==0){
3195 ZException.setMessage("ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex",wSt,Severity_Error,"Error while rebuilding index");
3196 }
3197 else {
3198 ZException.addToLast(" calling module <ZMasterFile::rebuildIndex>");
3199 }
3200 ComLog->appendTextColor( ErroredQCl, "%s-E rebuilding index key <%s> - rebuild process ended with error <%s>.\n"
3201 "Exception follows:\n%s",
3202 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3203 MasterFile->IndexTable[pIndexRankToRebuild]->IndexName.toString(),
3204 decode_ZStatus(wSt),
3205 ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toString());
3206
3207 QApplication::processEvents();
3208
3209 return wSt;
3210} //rebuildIndex

3233bool
3234FileGenerateMWn::ValuesControl() {
3235 utf8VaryingString wStr, wErrComp;
3236
3237 wStr.sprintf("Controlling values for (raw) master file creation or change ");
3238 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
3239 int wErrored=0;
3240
3241 if (AllocatedBlocks==0) {
3242 wErrComp += "Raw master file : Allocated blocks cannot be zero.\n";
3243 wErrored++;
3244 }
3245 if (ExtentQuota==0) {
3246 wErrComp += "Raw master file : ExtentQuota cannot be zero.\n";
3247 wErrored++;
3248 }
3249 if (MeanRecordSize==0) {
3250 wErrComp += "Raw master file : MeanRecordSize cannot be zero.\n";
3251 wErrored++;
3252 }
3253 if (AllocatedSize==0) {
3254 wErrComp += "Raw master file : AllocatedSize cannot be zero.\n";
3255 wErrored++;
3256 }
3257 if (MeanRecordSize > AllocatedSize) {
3258 wErrComp += "Raw master file : MeanRecordSize cannot be greater than AllocatedSize.\n";
3259 wErrored++;
3260 }
3261
3262 if (KeyValues->count() > 0) {
3263 for (long wi=0;wi < KeyValues->count(); wi ++) {
3264 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.isEmpty()) {
3265 wErrComp.addsprintf("Index <%ld> : IndexName cannot be empty.\n",wi);
3266 wErrored++;
3267 }
3268 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).KeySize==0) {
3269 wErrComp.addsprintf("Index <%ld><%s> : KeySize cannot be zero.\n",wi,KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.toString());
3270 wErrored++;
3271 }
3272 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).Allocated==0) {
3273 wErrComp.addsprintf("Index <%ld><%s> : Allocated blocks cannot be zero.\n",wi,KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.toString());
3274 wErrored++;
3275 }
3276 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).ExtentQuota==0) {
3277 wErrComp.addsprintf("Index <%ld> : ExtentQuota cannot be zero.\n",wi,KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.toString());
3278 wErrored++;
3279 }
3280 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).AllocatedSize==0) {
3281 wErrComp.addsprintf("Index <%ld><%s> : AllocatedSize cannot be zero.\n",wi,KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.toString());
3282 wErrored++;
3283 }
3284 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).KeySize > KeyValues->Tab(wi).AllocatedSize) {
3285 wErrComp.addsprintf("Index <%ld><%s> : KeySize cannot be greater than AllocatedSize.\n",wi,KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName.toString());
3286 wErrored++;
3287 }
3288 }// for
3289 }// if (KeyValues->count() > 0)
3290
3291 if (wErrored > 0) {
3292 ComLog->appendText(wErrComp);
3293 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Master file creation",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wErrComp,
3294 "%d errors have been detected.\n"
3295 "click <More> to have a detailed report",wErrored);
3296
3297 return true;
3298 }
3299 ComLog->appendText("Controls passed successfully.");
3300 return false;
3301}
