3303
3304void FileGenerateMWn::GenFile() {
3305
3306 if (RootName.isEmpty()){
3307 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Master file creation",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
3308 "File root name is missing.\n"
3309 "Cannot create file without root name.");
3310 return;
3311 }
3312
3313 _refresh(); /* update some booleans like GrabFreeSpace */
3314
3315 utf8VaryingString wStr;
3316 utf8VaryingString wErrComp;
3317 ZaiErrors wErrorLog;
3318 ZRawMasterFile* wMasterFile=new ZRawMasterFile;
3319 uriString wURIFile = TargetDirectory ;
3320 wURIFile.addConditionalDirectoryDelimiter();
3321 wURIFile += RootName;
3322 wURIFile += __MASTER_FILEEXTENSION__;
3323
3324 wStr.sprintf("Creating (raw) master file <%s>",wURIFile.toString());
3325 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
3326
3327 bool wBackup=false;
3328 const char* wF=nullptr;
3329 long wBadRank=0;
3330
3331 utf8VaryingString wMissfields;
3332 for (long wi=0;wi < KeyValues->count(); wi ++) {
3333 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).KeySize==0){
3334 wF="Guessed key size";
3335 wBadRank=wi;
3336 wMissfields.addsprintf(" Key <%s> field <%s> value 0 is invalid and must be guessed.\n",
3337 DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wBadRank]->DicKeyName.toString(),
3338 wF);
3339 }
3340 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).Allocated==0){
3341 wF="Allocated blocks";
3342 wBadRank=wi;
3343 wMissfields.addsprintf(" Key <%s> field <%s> value 0 is invalid and must be guessed.\n",
3344 DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wBadRank]->DicKeyName.toString(),
3345 wF);
3346 }
3347 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).ExtentQuota==0){
3348 wF="Extent quota";
3349 wBadRank=wi;
3350 wMissfields.addsprintf(" Key <%s> field <%s> value 0 is invalid and must be guessed.\n",
3351 DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wBadRank]->DicKeyName.toString(),
3352 wF);
3353 }
3354 if (KeyValues->Tab(wi).AllocatedSize==0){
3355 wF="Allocated size";
3356 wBadRank=wi;
3357 wMissfields.addsprintf(" Key <%s> field <%s> value 0 is invalid and must be guessed.\n",
3358 DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wBadRank]->DicKeyName.toString(),
3359 wF);
3360 }
3361 }
3362
3363 if (wF!=nullptr) {
3364 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("File generation",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wMissfields,
3365 "Cannot create file. Some invalid values have been detected.\n"
3366 "click <More> to have details.");
3367 return;
3368 }
3369
3370 if (ValuesControl()) {
3371 return;
3372 }
3373
3374 if (wURIFile.exists()) {
3375 uriStat wStat;
3376 wURIFile.getStatR(wStat);
3377
3378 int wRet = ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage3BHtml("Master file creation",Severity_Warning,"Backup","Cancel","Replace",
3379 nullptr,nullptr,
3380 " Found existing file <%s> \n"
3381 " It has been created <%s> and last modified <%s>\n"
3382 "<table>"
3383 "<tr><td>creates the file but backs up existing file</td> <td><b>Backup</b></td> </tr>"
3384 "<tr><td>replaces existing file without backup</td> <td><b>Replace</b></td> </tr>"
3385 "<tr><td>give up action</td> <td><b>Cancel</b></td> </tr>"
3386 "</table>",
3387 wURIFile.toString(),
3388 wStat.Created.toFormatted().toString(),
3389 wStat.LastModified.toFormatted().toString());
3390 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
3391 return;
3392
3393 if (wRet==ZEDLG_Third) {
3394 wBackup=true;
3395 }
3396
3397 }// if (wURIFile.exists())
3398
3399
3400 ZStatus wSt = wMasterFile->zcreateRawMasterFile( wURIFile,
3401 AllocatedBlocks,
3402 ExtentQuota,
3403 MeanRecordSize,
3404 AllocatedSize,
3405 HighWaterMarking,
3406 GrabFreeSpace,
3407 Journaling,
3408 wBackup,
3409 true);
3410
3411 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3412 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Master file creation",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,
3413 " Error while creating raw master file <%s> \n"
3414 " status <%s>",
3415 wURIFile.toString(),
3416 decode_ZStatus(wSt));
3417 return;
3418 }
3419 wStr.sprintf("%s - created Master file <%s>.",
3420 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3421 wURIFile.toString());
3422 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
3423
3424 /* create all indexes */
3425 uriString wIndexUri;
3426 long wIndexRank;
3427
3428
3429 if (IndexDirectory.isEmpty()){
3430 ComLog->appendText("%s - Index directory is omitted.",
3431 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString());
3432 }
3433 else {
3434 wSt=wMasterFile->setIndexFilesDirectoryPath(IndexDirectory);
3435 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3436 utf8VaryingString wErrContent = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage();
3437 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Set index path",Severity_Severe,nullptr,&wErrContent,
3438 "Error while setting index directory <%ld> ",
3439 IndexDirectory.toString());
3440 ComLog->appendText("Error while setting index directory <%ld> ",
3441 IndexDirectory.toString());
3442 ComLog->appendText(wErrContent);
3443
3444 wMasterFile->zclose();
3445 ComLog->appendText("Master file closed without index.");
3446 return;
3447 }
3448
3449 ComLog->appendText("%s - set index directory to <%s>.",
3450 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3451 IndexDirectory.toString());
3452 }
3453
3454
3455 if (KeyValues->count() == 0) {
3456 ComLog->appendText("%s - No index key has been defined.",
3457 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString());
3458 }
3459 else {
3460 for (long wi=0;wi < KeyValues->count(); wi ++) {
3461 wIndexUri = IndexDirectory ;
3462 wIndexUri.addConditionalDirectoryDelimiter();
3463 wIndexUri += KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexRootName;
3464
3465 wSt = wMasterFile->_createRawIndexDet (wIndexRank, /* returned key rank */
3466 KeyValues->Tab(wi).IndexName, /* Index name */
3467 KeyValues->Tab(wi).KeySize, /* Key universal total size */
3468 KeyValues->Tab(wi).Duplicates,
3469 KeyValues->Tab(wi).Allocated, /* ---FCB parameters (for index ZRandomFile)---- */
3470 KeyValues->Tab(wi).ExtentQuota,
3471 KeyValues->Tab(wi).AllocatedSize,
3472 HighWaterMarking,
3473 GrabFreeSpace,
3474 wBackup,
3475 &wErrorLog);
3476 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3477 utf8VaryingString wErrContent = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage();
3478 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Raw index creation",Severity_Severe,nullptr,&wErrContent,"Error while creating index rank <%ld> name <%s> file <%s>",
3479 wi,DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wi]->DicKeyName.toString(),wMasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
3480
3481 ComLog->appendTextColor(ErroredQCl,"%s-E-CREIDX Error while creating index rank <%ld> name <%s> for file <%s>\n"
3482 "Exception follows.\n%s",
3483 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3484 wi,DictionaryFile->KeyDic[wi]->DicKeyName.toString(),
3485 wMasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
3486 wErrContent.toString());
3487
3488
3489 wMasterFile->zclose();
3490 ComLog->appendText("Master file closed.");
3491 return;
3492 }
3493 wStr.sprintf("%s - created index file <%s>.",
3494 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString(),
3495 wMasterFile->getURIIndex(wIndexRank).toString());
3496 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
3497 } // for
3498 }// else
3499
3500 wStr.sprintf("%s - end creation.",
3501 ZDateFull::currentDateTime().toFormatted().toString());
3502// plainTextEdit->appendPlainText(wStr.toCChar());
3503 ComLog->appendText(wStr);
3504
3505
3506 /* File generation choices
3507
3508 Dictionary file exists and Master file does not exist
3509 -> may create a ZMasterFile with embedded dictionary
3510 -> a raw master file with no embedded dictionary
3511
3512 MasterFile exists (has been loaded) and Dictionary is null :
3513 -> MasterFile has no dictionary -> create a raw master file
3514 -> MasterFile has a dictionary -> may create a ZMasterFile with this embedded dictionary
3515
3516
3517 if both exist :
3518 -> create raw master file (no dictionary)
3519 -> create ZMF and update dictionary with given dictionary
3520
3521 if none exist :
3522 -> create a raw master file with given parameters with no embedded dictionary.
3523
3524 */
3525
3526 if (DictionaryFile==nullptr) {
3527 if (MasterFile==nullptr) {
3528 ComLog->appendText("No dictionary is available either embedded or loaded.");
3529 goto GenFileNoDic;
3530 }
3531 if (MasterFile->Dictionary==nullptr) {
3532 ComLog->appendText("Loaded master file has no dictionary : no dictionary has been embedded into created file.");
3533 goto GenFileNoDic;
3534 }
3535 /* here loaded master file has a dictionary */
3536 ZExceptionDLg::setFixedFont(true);
3537 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2BHtml("Generate file",Severity_Information,
3538 "Raw","Embedded",
3539 nullptr,nullptr,
3540 "A master file is loaded <%s>.\n"
3541 "Current Master file has its own embedded dictionary <%s>.\n"
3542 "<table>"
3543 "<th><tr>Create file </tr></th>"
3544 "<tr><td> as raw master file without dictionary</td> <td><b>Raw</b></td> </tr>"
3545 "<tr><td> as a master file using embedded dictionary</td> <td><b>Embedded</b></td> </tr>"
3546 "</table>",
3547 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString(),
3548 MasterFile->Dictionary->DicName.toString());
3549 if (wRet==ZEDLG_Rejected){
3550 goto GenFileNoDic;
3551 }
3552 wSt=wMasterFile->createDictionary(*MasterFile->Dictionary);
3553 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS){
3554 wErrComp = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage();
3555 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Embedding dictionary",Severity_Error,&ErrorLog,&wErrComp,
3556 "Cannot embed dictionary in master file.\n"
3557 "A raw master file with no dictionary is created and available.\n");
3558 goto GenFileNoDic;
3559 }
3560 goto GenFileEnd;
3561 } // if (DictionaryFile==nullptr)
3562
3563 if (DictionaryFile != nullptr) {
3564 if (MasterFile!=nullptr) {
3565
3566 if (MasterFile->Dictionary!=nullptr) {
3567 ZExceptionDLg::setFixedFont(true);

3602 goto GenFileNoDic;
3603 }

3605 case ZEDLG_Third: /* Raw requested */

3607 }// switch

3611 ZExceptionDLg::setFixedFont(true);
3612 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B("Generate file",Severity_Information,

3623 DictionaryFile->DicName.toString(),
3624 MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
3625 switch (wRet) {

3637 goto GenFileEnd;
3638 case ZEDLG_Rejected: /* Raw requested */

3640 }// switch
3641 goto GenFileNoDic;

3672 ComLog->appendTextColor(ErroredQCl,"%s-E-EMBEDDIC Cannot embed dictionary in master file.\n"

3754 ErrorLog.textLog("\n Created file <%s>\n",MasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
